objective:
Add a small `GET /api/queue/stats` route to `backend/src/routes/queue.ts` that
returns basic queue metrics (current entry count and average wait time) by
reading from `backend/src/db/queueEntries.ts`. Register the new route the
same way the existing `queue.ts` routes are already registered in
`backend/src/app.ts`. Add a corresponding test in `backend/src/routes/queue.test.ts`
following the existing test style in that file.
acceptance_criteria: `GET /api/queue/stats` returns 200 with `{ count, avgWaitMs }` for a non-empty queue.
Returns `{ count: 0, avgWaitMs: null }` for an empty queue.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` are both clean in `backend/`.
